name: doc-drift-lint
title: Lint the doc-vs-code drift the prose rule is not preventing
description: CLAUDE.md names doc/comment-vs-code drift as the most-flagged review pattern in this repo's history and asks reviewers to grep the old value. That prose rule is in place and the drift still ships: PRs #412/#413/#414 took nine review findings in one session, every one of them a doc or docstring asserting behavior the code does not have. Per the repo's own preference for a mechanical tools/check_*.py lint over a prose rule whenever the pattern is greppable, decide what is mechanically checkable here and build it.
creator: sdelmas
